title: Herbed Rice with Egg and Okra
subtitle: stir-fried short grain rice
description: Short grain rice is cooked al dente in a small amount of water, chilled, then stir-fried with okra, fresh herbs, silan, preserved lemon and egg.

ingredients.name: Mixed Fresh Herbs (Coriander, Mint, Parsley, Spring Onion, Dill)

steps.text: Bring the rice and water to the boil in a covered pot. Reduce the heat and cook for 20 minutes. Remove from the heat and leave covered for 10 minutes. Spread the rice on a tray or board and refrigerate for at least 4 hours (overnight is best).
Heat a frying pan or wok, add 1/4 cup olive oil and the okra, and fry over medium heat, stirring, for about 5 minutes until browned. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.

Heat the remaining olive oil in the same pan, add the rice and fry, stirring, for about 2 minutes. Add the chopped herbs, date syrup, spices and garlic and keep frying and stirring for about 3 more minutes.
Add the beaten egg and fry, stirring, for 2 more minutes. Return the okra, mix and serve immediately.
